write_up: Your resume tells a straightforward operations supervisor story: you moved from picking at Basin Retail Supply to leading outbound work at Sierra Freight Distribution. A recruiter can see the jobs and the people you've supervised, but has less to go on when comparing how the shifts performed.

The strongest line names the night shift of 35 associates and the picking, packing, and loading work you supervise. It gives a recruiter both the people and the work in one place. Your progression at Sierra is also easy to follow.
